name: birthdate
details: Used for month-level age at time zero and at definitive surgery. Confirm the site ETL has not truncated birthDate to year.

name: t0_day
description: Time zero: first encounter with a tier 1 medulloblastoma casedef code.
details: Time zero is the first study-population encounter carrying a tier 1 medulloblastoma casedef code (pcx__eligible_dx). Tier 2 and 3 codes are evidence only. NULL when the subject has only tier 2/3 evidence. Tables: pcx__eligible_*, pcx__outcome_*.

name: t0_source
details: Currently always casedef_tier1_medulloblastoma. Retained so alternative anchors (definitive surgery, treatment initiation) can be compared later.

name: age_months_at_t0
description: Completed months from birthdate to t0_day.
details: DATE_DIFF month. NULL when t0_day is NULL. The ACNS0334 criterion is age at definitive surgery, not at diagnosis; see age_months_at_definitive_surgery.

name: age_under_36_months_at_t0
details: Diagnosis-anchored convenience flag. Not the trial criterion.

name: age_band_at_t0
details: Stratifier for the all-ages discovery cohort (README section 1). NULL when t0_day is NULL.

name: age_under_8_months_at_t0
details: One of the four ACNS0334 high-risk qualifiers (diagnosis under 8 months). Adjudicate the stratum downstream with metastasis, histology and residual disease.

name: medulloblastoma_tier1_bool
description: TRUE when any tier 1 medulloblastoma casedef code exists for the subject.
details: Structured diagnosis evidence. Compare with llm_medulloblastoma_bool.

name: atrt_tier1_bool
description: TRUE when any tier 1 ATRT casedef code (9508/3, SNOMED 715659006) exists for the subject.
details: Tier 3 ATRT rows (unspecified brain neoplasm) are ignored here on purpose.

name: atrt_first_day
description: First encounter with a tier 1 ATRT casedef code.

name: atrt_confirmed_bool
description: TRUE when structured tier 1 or LLM diagnosis evidence names ATRT.
details: ACNS0334 exclusion. FALSE when neither source names ATRT, which is absence of evidence, not a pathology result. Table: pcx__eligible.

name: llm_medulloblastoma_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note gives disease_subtype MEDULLOBLASTOMA.
details: Source: pcx__llm_diagnosis_wide. NULL when the subject has no diagnosis-task output.

name: llm_atrt_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note gives disease_subtype ATRT.
details: Source: pcx__llm_diagnosis_wide. NULL when the subject has no diagnosis-task output.

name: llm_diagnosis_day_min
details: Hard cast to DATE. Precision is not carried here; month or year placeholders are first-of-period dates.

name: llm_diagnosis_gold_day_min
description: Earliest confirmatory tissue-diagnosis date across diagnosis-task notes.
details: Usually the resection or biopsy date. Candidate proxy for definitive surgery when no surgery evidence exists.

name: llm_age_months_at_diagnosis_gold
display: LLM age months at diagnosis gold
description: Completed months from birthdate to llm_diagnosis_gold_day_min.
details: Provisional age gate before running the surgery task.

name: llm_age_at_diagnosis_months_min
display: LLM age at diagnosis months min
description: Smallest explicitly stated age at diagnosis in months across notes.
details: Extracted text, not computed from dates.

name: llm_metastatic_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note states Chang M1 to M4.
details: Directly stated M-stage only. Derived staging from metastasis-task inputs is a downstream step.

name: llm_anaplastic_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note gives large-cell/anaplastic histology.
details: ACNS0334 high-risk qualifier.

name: definitive_surgery_day
description: Date of the definitive tumor resection.
details: Precedence: LLM surgery_role containing definitive, then first structured tier 1 craniotomy. See definitive_surgery_source. Table: pcx__eligible_surgery.

name: definitive_surgery_source
details: llm_surgery_role_definitive or proc_craniotomy_tier1_first. NULL when neither source has a date.

name: proc_craniotomy_tier1_first_day
details: Structured fallback for definitive surgery.

name: proc_craniotomy_tier1_cnt
description: Number of distinct tier 1 craniotomy procedures.
details: More than one suggests second-look or recurrence surgery is present.

name: llm_surgery_first_day
description: Earliest surgery_date across surgery-task notes, any role.

name: llm_definitive_surgery_day
description: Earliest surgery_date where surgery_role contains definitive.
details: surgery_role is free text in the current model, so this is a substring rule.

name: llm_age_at_definitive_surgery_months
display: LLM age at definitive surgery months
description: Explicitly stated age in months at the definitive operation.
details: Extracted text, compare with age_months_at_definitive_surgery.

name: llm_residual_tumor_area_cm2_min
description: Smallest explicit postoperative residual area in cm2.
details: Never inferred from GTR/NTR/STR labels.

name: llm_residual_tumor_area_cm2_max
description: Largest explicit postoperative residual area in cm2.
details: ACNS0334 high-risk threshold is 1.5 cm2; apply it downstream, not here.

name: llm_residual_disease_bool
description: TRUE when any surgery-task note gives extent PARTIAL_RESECTION or BIOPSY.
details: Label-based residual disease, distinct from a measured area.

name: age_months_at_definitive_surgery
description: Completed months from birthdate to definitive_surgery_day.
details: The ACNS0334 age criterion is evaluated on this column.

name: age_under_36_months_at_definitive_surgery
display: Age under 36 months at definitive surgery
details: ACNS0334 inclusion criterion. NULL when no definitive surgery date exists.

name: methotrexate_first_day
description: Earliest methotrexate date from any source.
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_order_first_day
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_administered_first_day
description: Earliest LLM-documented methotrexate administration start date.
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_any_bool
description: TRUE when any methotrexate order or administration exists.
details: Any dose, any route, any time (README section 2). Timing relative to the first event is in pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: methotrexate_administered_bool
description: TRUE when an LLM agent mention documents methotrexate as ADMINISTERED.
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_first_day
description: Earliest backbone chemotherapy date from any source.
details: Backbone agents are the six rx_chemo_* valuesets plus methotrexate. Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_order_first_day
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_administered_first_day
description: Earliest LLM-documented administered agent start date.
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_any_bool
description: TRUE when any backbone chemotherapy order or administration exists.
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order) and LLM systemic-therapy agents with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered). An order is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_prior_to_t0_bool
description: TRUE when chemo_first_day is before t0_day.
details: Feeds no_prior_chemotherapy_bool.

name: no_prior_chemotherapy_bool
description: ACNS0334 criterion: no chemotherapy before initial treatment.
details: FALSE when chemo_prior_to_t0_bool, TRUE when chemo exists only at or after t0_day, NULL when no chemotherapy evidence at all. Steroids are not chemotherapy. Table: pcx__eligible.

name: radiation_first_day
description: Earliest radiation date from any source.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_proc_first_day
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_dx_first_day
description: Earliest tier 1 radiotherapy encounter code recorded date.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_administered_first_day
description: Earliest LLM-documented delivered radiation start date.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_any_bool
description: TRUE when any radiation evidence exists, NULL when none.
details: Any dose, any field, any time (README section 2). Timing relative to the first event is in pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: radiation_administered_bool
description: TRUE when an LLM radiation round is ADMINISTERED.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: llm_craniospinal_bool
description: TRUE when any LLM radiation round has a craniospinal field.
details: CRANIOSPINAL or CRANIOSPINAL_WITH_FOCAL_BOOST.

name: llm_proton_bool
description: TRUE when any LLM radiation round uses protons.

name: llm_explicitly_not_received_bool
description: TRUE when a note explicitly documents that radiation was not received.
details: Explicit negative through the assessed date. Silence is NULL.

name: radiation_prior_to_t0_bool
description: TRUE when radiation_first_day is before t0_day.
details: Feeds no_prior_radiation_bool.

name: no_prior_radiation_bool
description: ACNS0334 criterion: no radiation before initial treatment.
details: FALSE when radiation_prior_to_t0_bool, TRUE when radiation exists only at or after t0_day or is explicitly not received, NULL when no radiation evidence at all. Table: pcx__eligible.

name: deceased_bool
description: TRUE when any source records death.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status. Sources: raw FHIR patient deceasedBoolean/deceasedDateTime, latest study-population encounter end, LLM patient task. A deceased flag without a date leaves death_day NULL.

name: death_day
description: Earliest recorded death date across sources.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status. Sources: raw FHIR patient deceasedBoolean/deceasedDateTime, latest study-population encounter end, LLM patient task. Actual death date, never a note date.

name: last_known_alive_day
description: Latest date the patient is documented alive.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status. Sources: raw FHIR patient deceasedBoolean/deceasedDateTime, latest study-population encounter end, LLM patient task. Latest of last encounter end and LLM last-known-alive. OS censoring date for patients without a death.

name: fhir_deceased_bool
description: Patient.deceasedBoolean from the raw FHIR patient table.
details: NULL when the site ETL does not populate it.

name: fhir_death_day
details: NULL when the site ETL does not populate it.

name: last_encounter_day
description: Latest enc_period_end_day_filled in the study population.
details: Administrative evidence only; a later note may extend last_known_alive_day.

name: llm_deceased_bool
description: TRUE when any patient-task note gives vital_status DECEASED.

name: llm_death_day
details: Hard cast to DATE, precision not carried.

name: llm_last_known_alive_day
details: Hard cast to DATE, precision not carried.

name: first_event_day
description: Date of the first EFS-type event.
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event. Undated events cannot be first events.

name: first_event_type
description: Event type(s) on first_event_day, comma-joined when several share the date.
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: any_event_bool
description: TRUE when a dated EFS-type event exists.
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: progression_first_day
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: recurrence_first_day
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: second_malignancy_first_day
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: undated_event_cnt
description: Number of EFS-type event mentions with no date.
details: Visible so a NULL first_event_day is not mistaken for no events.

name: days_t0_to_first_event
details: Negative values mean the event precedes time zero and need review.

name: methotrexate_prior_to_first_event_bool
description: Methotrexate received as initial therapy (README section 2).
details: TRUE when the first exposure day is before first_event_day or there is no event, FALSE when on or after it (salvage, not initial therapy), NULL when no dated exposure evidence at all. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: chemo_prior_to_first_event_bool
description: Backbone chemotherapy received as initial therapy.
details: TRUE when the first exposure day is before first_event_day or there is no event, FALSE when on or after it (salvage, not initial therapy), NULL when no dated exposure evidence at all. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure. Not a required stratifier; kept for the sequence column.

name: radiation_prior_to_first_event_bool
description: Radiation received as initial therapy (README section 2).
details: TRUE when the first exposure day is before first_event_day or there is no event, FALSE when on or after it (salvage, not initial therapy), NULL when no dated exposure evidence at all. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: initial_therapy_sequence
description: Order of chemotherapy and radiation within initial treatment.
details: CHEMOTHERAPY_BEFORE_RADIATION, RADIATION_BEFORE_CHEMOTHERAPY, SAME_DAY, CHEMOTHERAPY_ONLY, RADIATION_ONLY, or NULL. Uses chemo_first_day and radiation_first_day restricted to before the first event. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: protocol_names
description: Distinct treatment protocol names documented for the subject, pipe-joined.
details: From LLM regimen protocol_name_verbatim and timeline-anchor protocol_name. A protocol name does not establish enrollment, randomization or receipt.

name: os_event_bool
details: Overall survival per README section 3: origin t0_day, event death. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: os_end_day
description: death_day for deceased patients, otherwise last_known_alive_day.
details: Overall survival per README section 3: origin t0_day, event death. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: os_days
details: Overall survival per README section 3: origin t0_day, event death. Table: pcx__outcome. NULL when either date is missing, including deceased patients without a death date.

name: efs_event_bool
description: TRUE when a dated EFS-type event exists.
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: efs_end_day
description: first_event_day when an event exists, otherwise last_known_alive_day.
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome. Censoring on last-known-alive is a stand-in until dated event-free follow-up is adjudicated.

name: efs_days
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: efs_censor_source
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome. Every censored row says provisional on purpose.
